name: io.github.WellGr8/eqvector
title: EQVector
description: Personality assessment and self-discovery: MBTI, compatibility, Enneagram. Not clinical or hiring.

tools.name: start_quiz
tools.description: Start an anonymous EQVector short quiz of 24 questions in English or Thai. Returns a new session_id and the first question only (index 1, choices A and B). Answers are submitted with answer_question; the finished quiz returns a brief result with a deep link to the full test on eqvector.com. Not a clinical diagnosis; not intended for hiring or screening.

language.description: Quiz language: en for English, th for Thai. Defaults to en.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Submit choice A or B for the current question of an anonymous session. Takes the session_id and the 1-based index of the current question. Returns the next question, or the brief result and a deep link to the full test after the last answer. Not a clinical diagnosis; not intended for hiring or screening.

session_id.description: Anonymous quiz session id returned by start_quiz (field session_id). It is a UUID that is not linked to any person. Sessions expire after 24 hours.

choice.description: The option the person picked for the current question: A or B, exactly as shown.

index.description: 1-based number of the question being answered, as returned with that question. Answers are accepted only for the current question, in order from 1 to 24.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read the brief MBTI-style summary for a finished anonymous session: four letters, a one or two line description, a confidence label, and a deep link to the full 140-question test on eqvector.com. The full report, Enneagram, Tritype, and AI Coach are not included. Not a clinical diagnosis; not intended for hiring or screening.

session_id.description: Anonymous quiz session id returned by start_quiz (field session_id). It is a UUID that is not linked to any person. Sessions expire after 24 hours.

tools.name: lookup_celebrity
tools.description: Find a celebrity or fictional character in the EQVector database and return up to 5 matches with MBTI, Enneagram and a link to the profile on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

name.description: Full or partial name to search, e.g. Taylor Swift or Naruto.

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: compare_types
tools.description: Key differences between two MBTI types (letters, dominant functions, shared functions), EQVector's compatibility score, and the link to the full comparison page on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

type_b.description: Second MBTI type, different from type_a, e.g. INTP.

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_type_info
tools.description: Short summary of one MBTI type: nickname, preferences, cognitive functions, a few famous examples, and links to the type, celebrity and character pages on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

type.description: One of the 16 MBTI types, for example INTJ or enfp (case-insensitive).

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Work, love and friendship fit between two MBTI types from EQVector's compare data, with the compatibility score and the canonical compare page link. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: enneagram_wing_info
tools.description: One Enneagram wing (e.g. 4w5): nickname, core type, number of profiles in the EQVector database, the most common MBTI types among them, and the wing page link. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

wing.description: Enneagram wing: core type, w, adjacent wing, e.g. 4w5.

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: search_by_type
tools.description: List celebrities or fictional characters of one MBTI type from the EQVector database, with Enneagram and profile links. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

type.description: One of the 16 MBTI types, for example INTJ or enfp (case-insensitive).

category.description: real for real people, fictional for characters. When absent, both are included.

lang.description: Language of the linked eqvector.com pages: en, th, es or pt. Defaults to en.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.
